items.title: BRAC Bank, IFPRI to build digital financing ecosystem for farmers
items.description: BRAC Bank and the International Food Policy Research Institute (IFPRI) have recently partnered to expand digital payments and access to formal credit across Bangladesh’s agricultural value chains.

items.title: FAO to provide $447,000 for pesticide safety, women’s businesses
items.description: Bangladesh will receive $447,000 in grants from the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) for safer pesticide management and green businesses led by rural women.

items.title: Bank Asia wins WSBI SDG award 2026 again

items.title: Nagad app gets new look
items.description: Nagad, the mobile financial service of the Bangladesh Postal Department, has rolled out a redesigned mobile application aimed at making digital financial transactions faster, easier, and more secure.

items.title: Vietnam signs free trade deal with four EU nations
items.description: Vietnam and four European nations outside the EU signed a free trade agreement in Hanoi on Sunday, seeking to diversify their markets as US tariffs disrupt global commerce.

items.title: Pubali Bank opens 285th sub-branch in Uttara
items.description: Pubali Bank PLC on October 12 opened a new sub-branch in Uttara Sector 12 in Dhaka to provide modern banking services.
